verdict.rationale: Bruno's own materials state that it is offline-only with no cloud sync, no account and no login, and that collections are stored as plain-text files in a folder on the local filesystem. Community comments independently describe switching to Bruno because it avoids a cloud account and keeps collections as local text files. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that every feature works with no network connection at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work fully offline in a local workspace without a cloud account

citations.quote: Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.
No cloud sync. No account. No login.
Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem.
Then I found Bruno and fell in love.
